The summaries agree on the three audio connectors but the page itself did not state them, so beta-modelled; the ports are the Bêta proposal ports. 81 x 152 x 43 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering.
